essence: Not nine-self, not word-heap, not three-headed god.
Not nāda-drop, not moon-blockers, not wheel-joined.
Terrors of unawakened minds: mother's sweet for going on.
Free of direction, time, counting; unpointable, untellable.
Inner self-taste joy: Bhairavī's full-formed state.
Stainless world-filling body: who worships, which pleased?
Sung state: she, supreme goddess in supreme form.
Power-powerful non-difference: supreme power of supreme self.
Fire's burning not separate: entry begins it in knowing-being.
Entered power-state, undivided contemplation: Śiva-formed, Śaivī named.

rasa.dominant: adbhuta settling toward śānta (wonder of the unspeakable)
rasa.sthayibhava: vismaya settling into śama (wonder calming into quiescence)
rasa.justification: The denials pile wonder higher — each not-this makes the form stranger — and the passage lands on undivided contemplation and a named mouth, where wonder quiets into statement.

sections.SUMMARY: Every form denied: not nine-self, not word-heap, not three-headed, not nāda-drop, not wheel — free of direction, time and counting, untellable. Her terrors are a mother's sweet for going on. Then the positive: inner self-taste joy, full-formed Bhairavī; stainless world-filling body whose worship becomes the question; sung as supreme goddess, power-and-powerful undivided yielding supreme power; fire's burning only as entry in knowing-being; and the entered state — undivided contemplation, Śiva-formed, mouth called Śaivī.
sections.FUNCTION: Completes the object-question by exhausting forms, then names the form that survives denial.
sections.KEY TERMS: āveśa (possession-sickness — the negated danger); anuttara carried as unpointability; saṃvid (awareness as the only locus); Śaivī (the mouth — speech itself initiated); kṛtrima (made — the contrast with akṛtra elsewhere).
sections.LOCAL CONTEXT: The mouth named here (Śaivī) makes the coming dialogue itself the practice's vehicle — words as doors.
sections.BOUNDARY: Still no technique; the first breath-practice stands at the next section's threshold.
sections.EXPLANATION: The negation-verse pair works by exhaustion: self-division, word-heap, three-head, nāda-drop, moon-crescent, wheel-course — all pictures, none the thing. The terrors of unawakened readers are confessed as pedagogy (mother's sweet lures the child onward), and the unpointability is stated outright: free of direction, time and count. What survives is not another picture but a state — inner self-taste joy, Bhairavī full-formed — and a mouth: stainless world-filling body raising the worship-question, power-and-powerful as non-difference, fire's heat beginning only in knowing-being, and finally undivided contemplation entering the Śiva-form whose speech is Śaivī.
sections.RELATED: Hareesh upāya note (vv24+ = practices begin); the mouth (mukha) of v20 reappears as the request's door in the next song.
